info.description: Players load their circuit boards with answers, hoping to create matching connections with the other players. An unmatched signal shorts out, but connecting with exactly one other player generates bonus points. Complete rows and columns on your way to the highest score.
info.helpText:
Players sit in seats. Press the restart button to select a random player to begin. This game does not come with topics, so provide your own. A suggested way of doing this is for everyone to write a topic in the area below their seat. Then press the "Category" button on the right side of the screen which will select one at random. Or any player can just directly type the topic in the area at the top of the screen. Every player secretly enters 3 answers for that topic into any empty spaces on their board. Repeat with two more topics so that every player has 9 answers. An answer must contain no more than two words, except for proper nouns, and the same answer cannot appear twice on a player's board. Once the boards are filled in, press the "Check" button on the right side to activate the symbols overlays. Starting with the first player and proceeding clockwise, each player announces one of their unmarked answers. An answer that has already been announced during the round cannot be announced again. Resolve the announced answer as follows:
  • Two or more other players match: Everyone with that answer, including the active player gets a check mark. Click the box where the answer is one time.
  • Exactly one other player matches: Both players get a check mark. Also, click the star in the box.
  • Nobody matches: The active player gets an X in the box and scores nothing for it. Click the box twice for an X.
Continue until one player has marked all nine of their answers. That player declares they are finished, and the round ends immediately.
Score 1 point for each checked answer, 2 additional points for each marked star, and the printed bonus value for every completed row or column with 3 answers checked. Crossed-out and still-unmarked answers score nothing. Enter points in the 3 boxes at the top right side of the board. The first box is for checked answers. The second box is for filled stars. The last box is the sum of all row and column points. Round and total scores are calculated automatically. Synonyms expressing the same specific idea may count as matches, but a broad category and a more specific example do not. Players decide any disputed matches.

After scoring, press the "Round" button in the lower right. The lowest-scoring player starts the next round. The player with the highest total score after 3 rounds wins.
